name: Candle of Invocation

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Light the candle
powers.text: While it burns (up to 4 hours in all), you and your allies within 30 ft have Advantage on attack rolls, saves and checks, and a Cleric or Druid within 30 ft can cast level 1 spells without slots.

powers.name: Gate
powers.text: Use up the candle to cast Gate.

summary: Lit, it gives you and your allies within 30 ft Advantage on attacks, saves and checks; or it opens a Gate.
text: Each of these thin tapers is consecrated to a god and holds that god's alignment. Lighting it is a Magic action, and it burns for 4 hours in total before it is consumed. You can put it out early and save the rest, subtracting the time used in 1-minute increments. The flame casts Dim Light out to 30 feet. Any creature in that glow sharing the candle's alignment has Advantage on attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws, and a Cleric or Druid of the matching alignment there can cast prepared level 1 spells without spending a spell slot, the spell working as though cast at level 1. Instead, the very first time you light it, you may cast Gate through it, which destroys the candle. (Alignment isn't tracked in the game, so the blessing simply covers the party.)
